name: Baccarat
tagline: Back the Player or the Banker: closest to nine wins.
rulesSummary: Everyone bets against the house on which hand wins each coup: Player, Banker or Tie. Nobody holds cards; the house deals and draws by fixed rules.
Aces count 1, two to nine their number, tens and faces 0. Only the last digit counts: 7 and 8 make 5. Closest to 9 wins.
Each hand gets two cards. An 8 or 9 is a natural and both stand. Otherwise the Player draws a third card on 0–5 and stands on 6 or 7.
If the Player stood, the Banker draws on 0–5. If the Player drew, the Banker draws on 0–2; on 3 unless that card was an 8; on 4 against 2–7; on 5 against 4–7; on 6 against 6–7.
One bet a coup. Player pays 1:1, Banker 1:1 less 5% (rounded down), Tie 8:1. On a tie, Player and Banker bets come back.
Most chips after the last coup wins.
